subject: Why don't we include observation covariates with distamp?

messages.author: ea9bc04d739ab6cb
messages.subject: Why don't we include observation covariates with distamp?
parts:
Hi Everyone,
I'm putting together a model in distsamp using distance data collected from line transects and am curious as to why there isn't an option to include observation covariates?
Thanks for your input.
Amy

messages.author: 403be63af7ebf220
messages.subject: Re: [unmarked] Why don't we include observation covariates with distamp?
parts:
Hi Amy,

For this model, observation covariates would have to be defined at the level of the distance interval, and it's hard for me to imagine what those would be. Do you have an example?

Richard

messages.author: 403be63af7ebf220
messages.subject: Re: [unmarked] Why don't we include observation covariates with distamp?
parts:
Hi Amy,

That is correct. However, if you have fine scale vegetation data represented in raster layers, you could use spatial distance sampling models like those described in chapter 9 of Applied Hierarchical Modeling (2016, Academic Press). Eventually, we would like to implement these models in unmarked, but it won't happen any time soon.

Richard
